richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Agra

c: Agra swings between some of the hottest summers in north India and cold, foggy winter mornings. Any outdoor gym equipment supplier in Agra has to make machines that sit outside through both. FunPlay Systems builds its Fun Fitness range at our factory in Vasai, about 1,010 km away. We install it in Agra for municipal parks, colonies, schools, colleges and hotel staff areas.

That temperature range affects how you plan the site. In May and June, metal and dark plastic left in direct sun get too hot to hold by mid-morning, so morning and evening walkers are your main users and shade matters. In December and January, fog leaves the equipment damp at dawn, and footplates need a grip pattern so feet do not slip. Our seats and footplates are textured roto-moulded plastic, and the frames are galvanised steel. Tell us where the sun falls on your site and we will position each machine on the layout drawing.

richText.heading: A balanced set for an Agra colony park

c: Most colony parks in Agra already have a walking track, so an open gym works best as a cluster beside it. A useful set pairs a cardio machine with strength and mobility stations. The

items.q: Does outdoor gym equipment get too hot to use in Agra's summer?
items.a: Machines in full sun do heat up by late morning. Place the gym under trees or a shade structure, and most people will use it in the early morning and evening anyway.

items.q: Can you install machines in an existing park without breaking the walking track?
items.a: Yes. We mark the stations beside the track on a layout drawing. Each machine is grouted or self-standing on its own base, so the track itself is left alone.
